Priya R: Heads-up — I need someone to cover ARB facilitator next Wed (2026-04-08). I'm OOO that week. Thinking we should run a compact 45m: roll call, two RFCs (<=12m each), then triage/parking lot. Volunteers? Proposed order below:

```
1) 5m - roll call + quick action follow-ups
2) 12m - RFC: storage sharding (Miguel H) - final decision
3) 12m - RFC: KV prefix caching (Liam K) - discuss perf numbers
4) 16m - triage (top 3 items)
```

Please ping if you can take facilitator or backup. @here

Liam K: I can cover facil if Marcus does triage. I might need +3 mins for a short demo.

Marcus D: I can do triage. Quick ask — can we deprioritize the prefix caching RFC? I'm waiting on perf runs, still noisy :grimacing:.

Ava S: I can be backup facilitator if anything changes. :raised_hands:

Miguel H: FYI I pushed an updated deck with perf plots and action items. Link: https://redwood-internal/drive/rfc-storage-v3 (internal)
Small note: prefer docs-first decision, include a fallback proposal in slide 6.

DevOpsBot: calendar: Event 'ARB - 2026-04-08' created with Liam K as host, Marcus D as co-host. ics attached.

Priya R: Thanks — Liam primary, Ava backup, Marcus triage. Marcus, moving KV prefix RFC to next week's slot — Miguel storage stays. I'll trim slides to keep timing.

Marcus D: sounds good, thx.
